compressionBaseline.roleAssignment: occupant ↔ role relation bound to scope/currentness/provenance
compressionBaseline.scopedAuthorityEdge: typed relation saying which holder may perform which operation over which object/consequence, under which scope/condition/time/source, and whether the result is binding
compressionBaseline.contributionEdge: non-identity relation carrying evidence/advice/proposal/control contribution into another decision/action process
compressionBaseline.adjudicationView: case-level evidence/interpretation/ruling/review projection over existing state/relation/rule/authority semantics

strongSeparations: FinalAuthority is scope/time/operation-relative, not a universal rank
MultipleFinalAuthorities can coexist on disjoint or explicitly shared scopes
AuthorityTopology need not be a tree or total order
RoleConflict != semantic impossibility; it is a practice/integrity constraint over composed grants
Human vs synthetic substrate does not determine authority validity

varies: recommendation/input holder vs final decision holder
boundaryCases.result: evidence/review contribution is separable from binding case-ruling authority
RoleAssignment/current authority can change without changing Role identity or Game identity; replacement is sourced by competition rule
ability to revise a decision is temporally/conditionally scoped; authority possession alone is insufficient

boundaryCases.case: Magic floor judge → Head Judge appeal

boundaryCases.case: Magic Head Judge temporary duty transfer

boundaryCases.case: Magic Tournament Organizer may replace Head Judge in exceptional circumstances
boundaryCases.result: authority to appoint/replace an adjudicator is distinct from authority to adjudicate the case
there need not be one globally maximal authority node; multiple equally final authorities can exist under declared scopes

heldFixed: spectator has no player action/judge ruling authority
boundaryCases.result: a role may contribute evidence or trigger process without receiving adjudication authority

boundaryCases.case: Coach advice under allowed vs prohibited coaching rules
varies: practice rule admitting the advice channel
boundaryCases.result: causal influence and legitimate contribution depend on current rule/scope; advice does not transfer player action authority
binding Game effect can belong to aggregation/admission rule while individual members possess only contribution rights
same role label does not determine unique authority scope; authority can be partitioned among several occupants
practice-record validity may change without rewriting original World/GameInstance history

varies: who can change general rule vs who can bind current case under current rule
who records/applies score, sanction, restart, access change
boundaryCases.result: decision authority and consequence execution can be separately allocated
authority to adapt content/dynamics is distinct from Player GameAction and case adjudication

varies: whether both authority grants are co-located or separated
boundaryCases.result: conflict-of-interest is a constraint over grant composition, not evidence for a new Entity/Role primitive

boundaryCases.result: authority semantics need not depend on biological substrate; legitimacy/currentness still require practice authority
authority and ruling validity are version/currentness-bound
